note: Example registry. Copy to registry.json and fill real values locally; keep no secrets here. Slot times are KST.

experiment_kill_rule.stop_if: every one of the first 3 uploads has views_48h < 500 AND engaged_views/views at 48 h < 30%
experiment_kill_rule.action: stop scheduling new uploads; delete nothing, published videos stay
experiment_kill_rule.otherwise: continue, re-judged every 7 days against the baseline channel
experiment_kill_rule.source: example; set the rule your team agreed
